title: Rav Chanan bar Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shemot Rabbah 42:4: Rabbi Berekhyah said in the name of Rabbi Chelbo, in the name of Rav Chanan bar Yosef, in the name of Rabbi Abba bar Aivu. Hyman suggests that the reading should be Rabbi Anan bar Yosef, as in Pesikta deRav Kahana, piska Shuvah, and Midrash Tehillim 65:4.

notes.text: The consulted Shemot Rabbah has Chanan. The Mandelbaum Pesikta has Anan bar Rabbi Yose in a different chain, and Midrash Tehillim has Anan bar Yosef reporting Rav Idi with others. Hyman’s proposed reading concerns the name.
